title: Levin Jackson
clean_html:
Levin Jackson

Preserved Primary Document • jacksonl.htm

Levin Jackson was the son of Robert B. Jackson and Lydia Wright. He was born in Sussex Co., DE on 28 October, 1893. On 31 May, 1914 he married Caroline Coker in Cheswold, Kent Co., DE. He and his wife later moved to Wilmington where they lived for the rest of their lives at 508 East 9th Street.. Levin died on 18 November, 1981 and is buried with his wife at Immanuel Union (Manship) Church in Cheswold, DE Levin and Caroline had the following children: Beatrice Jackson (12/16/1915 - 3/1/2004 ) married William Jackson (1915-1989) both are buried at Indian Mission Church in Sussex Co., DE Francis Lawrence Jackson (1922-1998) married Araminta Morgan Wagner Dupont Jackson (9/23/1923-9/15/2003) married #1 Roma Quinn and #2 Arva Marshall Children of Wagner and Arva Jackson are: Wagner D. Jackson Jr Jeffre Jackson Janine Jackson married James Kearney Martin Naureckas Lenox Lacey Jackson (1927- ) married Alma Wangus They had one child: Lenox Lacey Jackson Jr.
